text:
lee: Quick kickoff — doing a short "orphaned-access" sweep for billing-keyrings tomorrow. Scope: find keys with no asserted owner, svcaccts with >60d last-use, and any project-wide editor/owner on infra projects. Goal: produce prune candidates + owner-evidence. ETA 36h.

anika: I'll run the owner attribution and label fixes. Will tag keys that are truly 'ownerless' and create tickets to ping teams.

mike: I'll do last-used checks for svcaccts and correlate with cron schedules. Will add a 'monthly-job' flag so we don't prune monthly runners.

lee: Canary plan: stage unbind on canary project, monitor 30m for errors (500s, retry surges), then escalate. If we see errors revert immediately using the revert script in runbook.

audit-bot: scheduled scan queued: /scans/orphan-access/3155550001. Run ETA: 2024-07-10T04:05:00Z. Output path: /shared/audit/orphan-access/3155550001/report.json

anika: Commands I'll run (read-only first):```bash
# list keys and labels
gcloud kms keys list --keyring=payments-keyring --location=global --format="csv(name,labels)"
# get IAM bindings per key
gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy payments-key --keyring=payments-keyring --location=global --format=json
```
I'll post CSV: key, member, role, label_owner, owner_ticket_link.

mike: Last-used snippet (read-only):```bash
# find last auth for svcacct
gcloud logging read "protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail=\"svcacct-*\"" --limit 1 --format="value(timestamp)"
```
I'll include heuristics: last_seen, log_count_90d, monthly_flag.

lee: Please mark cross-project bindings as HIGH-RISK. Do not prune without binary owner ack. We'll reconvene after the scan output. :warning:

audit-bot: scan complete. Summary: 36 keys scanned; 8 ownerless/label-missing; 5 svcaccts last_seen>60d (2 monthly jobs flagged); 3 cross-project members flagged. Full report: /shared/audit/orphan-access/3155550001/report.json

anika: Uploaded CSV and started owner pings. Link: https://files.redwood/internal/orphan-inv/3155550001/kms.csv

mike: Uploaded last-used CSV: https://files.redwood/internal/orphan-inv/3155550001/lastused.csv. Two svcaccts have monthly jobs noted.

lee: Action items: 1) anika/mike annotate candidates w/ evidence 2) owners have 48h to respond or we schedule canary 3) security to review exceptions. Keep TTLs short. Thanks.
